sn4.22:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati silāvatiyaṃ.
sn4.22:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā samiddhi bhagavato avidūre appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharati.
sn4.22:1.3: atha kho āyasmato samiddhissa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi.
sn4.22:1.4: lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
sn4.22:1.6: lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
sn4.22:1.8: lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
sn4.22:1.10: atha kho māro pāpimā āyasmato samiddhissa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya yenāyasmā samiddhi tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmato samiddhissa avidūre mahantaṃ bhayabheravasaddaṃ akāsi, apissudaṃ paṭhavī maññe udrīyatīti.
sn4.22:2.1: atha kho āyasmā samiddhi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā samiddhi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn4.22:2.2: idhāhaṃ bhante bhagavato avidūre appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharāmi.
sn4.22:2.3: tassa mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
sn4.22:2.4: lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me,
sn4.22:2.6: lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me,
sn4.22:2.8: lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me,
sn4.22:2.10: tassa mayhaṃ bhante avidūre mahābhayabheravasaddo ahosi, apissudaṃ paṭhavī maññe udrīyatīti. [bhagavā:]
sn4.22:3.2: māro eso pāpimā. tuyhaṃ vicakkhukammāya āgato.
sn4.22:3.3: gaccha tvaṃ samiddhi tattheva appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharāhīti.
sn4.22:3.4: evambhanteti kho āyasmā samiddhi bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn4.22:3.5: dutiyampi kho āyasmā samiddhi tattheva appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihāsi.
sn4.22:3.6: dutiyampi kho āyasmato samiddhissa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi. lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me …pe… yassa me sabrahmacārayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammāti.
sn4.22:3.7: dutiyampi kho māro pāpimā āyasmato samiddhissa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya …pe…
sn4.22:3.9: atha kho āyasmā samiddhi māro ayaṃ pāpimā iti viditvā māraṃ pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
sn4.22:5.1: atha kho māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ samiddhi bhikkhūti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.
